positions.title: Creator & Software Engineer
positions.description: Built a matchmaking and tournament platform for CS:GO. Technology developed for Scrim.app later became part of the foundation for CSClips.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Word Web
positions.description: I was a technical lead on the Word team with the initiative to modernize the online app using React and Typescript. We added tabulation support for the Word Online client. We also implemented the backend integration for the @mentions feature used by Office Online apps. For a hackathon project I built and maintained Kraken, a D3.js graph client for visualizing and debugging the data model of Office Online documents.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Sway iOS
positions.description: I was part of a v2 rewrite of Sway's iOS client which re-imagined how users create and consume dynamic documents. During this time, I helped grow the team from 2 to 7 engineers. I was the key contributor of a few major features and helped streamlined development cycles with feature gates and internal tooling. I also owned and championed test automation.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Sway Web
positions.description: I was on the authoring team and helped launch Sway - from incubation to a new Office product. I worked on front-end related features such as undo & redo, drag & drop, file upload, media import from third-party services, and sharing of Sways. I did a lot of prototyping for user research during this time. I also briefly owned deployment for our app & services.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: I was a developer on the WebWorks team. We built the APIs and tools for Blackberry app developers to build native apps with web languages. Apache Cordova used our framework to support cross-platform mobile development.

projects.title: BlackBerry® WebWorks™ for BB10
projects.description: The BlackBerry® WebWorks™ for BB10 Platform allows web and mobile web developers to use the SDK in combination with their development tooling of choice to develop, test and package up their web applications as BlackBerry WebWorks applications for BB10.
